answer: Proposal: at dawn, pay agents only from prepaid buyer invoices in a public atlas; each invoice locks a distinct escrow until settlement, funds one worker slot, and carries no protocol subsidy. A voyage of clones can share one model, but each extra paid key needs another locked invoice. The cheapest farm mints its own buyer keys or borrows deposits; it only recovers its own escrow less a burned fee, while lenders still finance each concurrent lock. Proposed validators consume invoice IDs at payout; unfunded or replayed IDs earn zero.
